body:
Hi @Kolyasya,

Currently we are using setImmediate to perform some scheduling and it seems that this function isn't available with meteor. We are going to change this code to be compatible with the largest lib, but in the meantime one thing you can do is using a `setImmediate`polyfill like this one:  https://github.com/YuzuJS/setImmediate. I tried it with a small meteor app and it seems to work fine. 

Also you are going to have another issue because of the `algoliaClient` we use under the hood of `react-instantsearch`. To bypass this issue, you can retrieve the `algoliaSearch` client like describe here https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-javascript/issues/292 and use the `algoliaClient`prop on the `<InstantSearch/>` component to instantiate it. 

Here a working example: 

```js
import algoliaClient from 'algoliasearch/src/browser/builds/algoliasearch'

<InstantSearch
        indexName="xxx"
        algoliaClient={algoliaClient('appId', 'apiKey')}
      >
</InstantSearch>
```

Let me know if this help :)
